explainability.aggregation: Sum absolute token contributions across occurrences and all four classes, divided by 4 classes and all 120 messages. Tokens include subwords. Absences count as zero.
explainability.scope: Explains raw classifier probabilities, not the 0.8 fallback, the pending-reminder guard, danger detection, or clinical safety.

explanation_settings.rng: numpy legacy seed 42 per explanation, caller state restored

provenance.metrics_predictions: MuRIL argmax is routed to question below 0.8. No pending-reminder state is assumed for any model in this benchmark.
provenance.roc_auc: Multiclass one-vs-rest, macro and support-weighted, from raw MuRIL probabilities in labels order, before confidence fallback.
